q: How many products do we have?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products

q: كم عدد المستودعات؟
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouses

q: List all product categories
gold: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products

q: What is the most expensive product?
gold: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many suppliers are in Jeddah?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM suppliers WHERE city='Jeddah'

q: كم منتج عندنا بفئة Safety؟
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category='Safety'

q: What is the SKU of the Safety Helmet?
gold: SELECT sku FROM products WHERE name='Safety Helmet'

q: Which supplier provides the Safety Helmet?
gold: SELECT s.name FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.id=p.supplier_id WHERE p.name='Safety Helmet'

q: How many units of Safety Helmet are in the Riyadh warehouse?
gold: SELECT sl.quantity FROM stock_levels sl JOIN products p ON p.id=sl.product_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=sl.warehouse_id WHERE p.name='Safety Helmet' AND w.city='Riyadh'

q: List the products supplied by suppliers rated above 4.5
gold: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.id=p.supplier_id WHERE s.rating>4.5

q: كم صنف عند كل مورد؟
gold: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) FROM suppliers s JOIN products p ON p.supplier_id=s.id GROUP BY s.id

q: Which warehouse holds the most units of Barcode Scanner?
gold: SELECT w.name FROM stock_levels sl JOIN products p ON p.id=sl.product_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=sl.warehouse_id WHERE p.name='Barcode Scanner' ORDER BY sl.quantity DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the total inventory value across all warehouses?
gold: SELECT SUM(sl.quantity*p.unit_price) FROM stock_levels sl JOIN products p ON p.id=sl.product_id

q: كم قيمة المخزون الإجمالية بكل مستودع؟
gold: SELECT w.name, SUM(sl.quantity*p.unit_price) FROM stock_levels sl JOIN products p ON p.id=sl.product_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=sl.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.id

q: Which category has the most products?
gold: SELECT category FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: Average unit price per category
gold: SELECT category, AVG(unit_price) FROM products GROUP BY category

q: Total units in stock per warehouse
gold: SELECT w.name, SUM(sl.quantity) FROM stock_levels sl JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=sl.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.id

q: شو الأصناف اللي كميتها الكلية أقل من أو تساوي حد إعادة الطلب؟
gold: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN stock_levels sl ON sl.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id HAVING SUM(sl.quantity) <= p.reorder_level

q: How many sales orders were placed in the last 7 days?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_orders WHERE order_date >= date('now','-7 day')

q: Total units received from suppliers in the last 30 days
gold: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='in' AND movement_date >= date('now','-30 day')

q: مين أكثر مورد وردّ لنا آخر 30 يوم؟
gold: SELECT s.name FROM stock_movements m JOIN suppliers s ON s.id=m.supplier_id WHERE m.movement_type='in' AND m.movement_date >= date('now','-30 day') GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY SUM(m.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

q: Top 3 best selling products in the last 30 days by units
gold: SELECT p.name FROM sales_order_items i JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= date('now','-30 day') GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(i.quantity) DESC LIMIT 3

q: Total revenue from sales orders in the last 30 days
gold: SELECT SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) FROM sales_order_items i JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= date('now','-30 day')
